lead.label: MAN014
lead.why: Abstract: 'The identified lead compound, MAN014, can be used as an antimicrobial...'

reactions.conditions: General procedure 6.2: sugar (0.5 g, 1 equiv) and acyl chloride (1.5 equiv) stirred in pyridine (20 mL) overnight at rt; concentrated, silica gel chromatography (EtOAc to EtOAc/MeOH 9:1). Also run at 30 g scale (1.5 equiv myristoyl chloride, 48%).
reactions.source: Main article sections 2, 4, 6.2 and 6.11 (MAN014 1.33 mmol, 48%, a/b anomers 3:1)

notes: One-step regioselective acylation. Product is a mixture of alpha/beta anomers (3:1); SMILES leaves the anomeric centre unspecified, other stereocentres are D-manno. Minor 2-O-acyl regioisomer (about 4:1 6-O:2-O at small scale) and the di-acyl by-product (28%) are noted in the paper; MAN014 is drawn as the 6-O ester per the paper's name. Name of mannose is printed as 'mannose'/'D-mannose' in text; the myristoyl chloride name is from the text of section 4. DMAP mentioned only in the purity remark, not in the general procedure.
